# Cave Wave Car Wash
> Professional car wash services across East Texas

Cave Wave Car Wash provides expert professional car wash services and solutions. We are committed to delivering high-quality, reliable service to our clients at every visit. Our state-of-the-art facilities feature the latest in automatic tunnel wash technology, unlimited wash memberships, and premium detailing services.

## Services
- Express Exterior Wash
- Fast Pass Unlimited Wash Club
- Premium Detail Station
- Free Vacuum & Mat Cleaning
- Interior Detailing
- Hand Waxing & Clay Bar Treatments

## About
Cave Wave Car Wash is a professional car wash company dedicated to providing expert solutions across East Texas. We are fully licensed and insured, ensuring our clients receive reliable, high-quality service they can trust. Our experienced team operates state-of-the-art tunnel wash systems designed to handle vehicles of all sizes while protecting your vehicle's finish.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What wash packages do you offer?**
We offer four FastPass membership packages: Basic Wave ($24.99/month), Splash Wave ($29.99/month), Mega Wave ($39.99/month), and Tidal Wave ($49.99/month). Single washes are also available.

**How does the FastPass membership work?**
FastPass uses license plate recognition technology for contactless entry to our express member lanes. No tags or stickers needed. Wash unlimited times per month at any location.

**What's included with every wash?**
All washes include free access to our detailing stations with Armor All, glass cleaner, fragrances, air blowers, vacuums, and microfiber rags.

**What are your hours?**
Longview and Texarkana: Monday–Sunday 8AM–8PM. Paris: Monday–Sunday 8AM–7PM.

**Do you offer single washes?**
Yes, single washes are available at all locations, but our unlimited monthly plans offer the best value.

**How do I contact you?**
Longview: (903) 305-5365. Texarkana: (903) 733-1628. Paris: (806) 778-2602. Or visit www.cavewavecarwash.com.
